relations.rationale: Organizing teams sets up the context in which Sami could later rank those teams by litter collected.
Organizing teams into small groups makes it possible for a team like Yara's to come out ahead, but doesn't specifically indicate that outcome.
Organizing teams has no bearing on relative height between Sami and Ivo.
Pointing out which stretches needed attention doesn't determine which team collected the most litter by midday.
Pointing out sand stretches needing attention has no relation to the number of houses in the school.
Yara and Dev being in different houses doesn't determine whether Dev and Leo are in different houses.
Yara and Dev being in different houses doesn't determine whether Yara and Leo are in different houses.
Yara and Dev being in different houses is consistent with there being three houses but doesn't establish the total count.
If Ivo did not take the photographs, then it is false that Ivo took the photographs.
Whether Ivo took photographs has no bearing on what was found in the tide pools.
Whether Ivo took photographs has no bearing on how much care the fishing line removal took.
Ivo not taking photographs has no bearing on his arrival time relative to Leo.
Sami's age relative to Dev has no bearing on the effect of her height relative to Leo on visibility.
Sami being younger than Dev has no bearing on her ranking the teams by litter collected.
Sami's age relative to Dev has no bearing on her height relative to Ivo.
Sami being younger than Dev is independent of her being older than Ivo, involving different people.
Sami being taller than Leo directly supports the claim that this height difference made her easy to spot.
Sami being taller than Leo doesn't determine her height relative to Ivo, a different person.
Sami's height relative to Leo has no bearing on everyone gathering for a last look at the shoreline.
Sami's visibility due to height has no bearing on the difficulty of removing tangled fishing line.
